description: For a given file path, generate a 12-byte nonce via RAND_bytes(), read file content, encrypt using AES-256-GCM via EVP_CIPHER_CTX with the session key and nonce. Write output file named <original>.PROCESSED containing: 12-byte nonce, ciphertext, 16-byte GCM tag. Overwrite original with zero bytes and remove() it.
name: apply_transform
